# Reciprocal Disposition

The r0.18 owner-approved
`NOI-UNC/INVERSE-CONDITIONAL-SECOND-MOMENT-SCALE` bytes remain immutable
history. r0.3 has no owner decision removing them from history, retaining them
in the ordinary base bundle, or approving a renamed successor.

Present base-v0.1 state:

- no reciprocal product is placed in the ordinary base bundle;
- reciprocal, inverse variance, precision, and consumer-weight products are
  unavailable;
- STD consumes `sqrt(Vhat_cond)` directly;
- `1/Vhat_cond` is never called an inverse scale.

If later retained, the exact successor product name shall be
`reciprocal_conditional_randomization_second_moment`, with finite-positive
parent domain, separate method/profile identity, exact consumer use, and no
precision, weight, validity, support, exposure, or coefficient interpretation.
This conditional naming rule is not owner approval or Registry binding.
